# Airship: ouroboros.bot home hero

## Story
Ari's agents sail his glass-and-brass airship above the clouds at sunrise while he, faceless, stands calmly at the bow looking out, his pet snake Ouro on the rail beside him.

## Camera
35 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: just above the person's head, as if we stand on the stern step behind them. We look across the open deck toward the curved bow on the right. One vanishing point, on the horizon just right of centre, where the deck planks, the rail and the envelope's ribs all converge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024 as the centre of a 3072x1024 master: the left side is outpainted with more deck and the right side with open sky, so the full height ships. Safe area and crop band: the phone crop band keeps the left five-sixths of this picture, and every head, hand, foot and Ouro sits between rows 150 and 900, and every figure's feet are visible on the deck, with no object's edge at a figure's ankle. The gondola fills the left two-thirds; its curved bow ends about three-quarters of the way across, and the right quarter is open sky, sea of cloud, snowy peaks and the low sun. The upper left stays calm envelope glass and sky.

## Cast

### The person
- What: Ari, as a faceless adult person from the shared universe, standing at the bow and looking out at the horizon.
- Material: smooth, seamless, clear-to-lightly-frosted glass head and hands with a soft warm inner light, warm white turning amber at the core; no face at all, no features; never saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the body height, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like.
- Height: the tallest figure by far; the top of Loop's head reaches the person's belt.
- Outfit: a well-cut dark-brown leather flight jacket with a cream shearling collar, charcoal wool trousers and brown leather boots, and a deep moss-green wool scarf wrapped once at the neck with both ends streaming back toward the stern (left of frame) in the wind, behind the shoulders and away from both arms.
- Expression: faceless; calm confidence shown by the body: upright, shoulders square and relaxed, chin level toward the horizon, weight settled evenly on both feet.
- Pose: standing at the bow rail, both feet flat on the deck planks inside the rail.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) hand: wrapped round the barrel of a short, closed brass spyglass, lowered at the hip. Far (right) hand: resting closed on the brass rail cap in front of the person.
- Facing: body faces the bow (right of frame), seen three-quarters from behind, back mostly to the camera; the head looks out over the bow.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the person's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless translucent emerald glass with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as the person's forearm is long, and much smaller than any agent.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: content and alert, enjoying the wind, eyes soft.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" sitting upright on the rail cap a short step forward of the person's resting hand, the ring open at the top right: his head comes over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the brass.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the horizon, so the camera sees one eye and the curve of his smile.

### Loop
- What: Loop, the helmsman agent, a small robot.
- Material: smooth, seamless pale-jade glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round brass ear disc and a tiny brass antenna with an emerald bead.
- Height: the top of his head reaches the person's belt; the tallest agent.
- Outfit: brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead and a short green flying scarf streaming back toward the stern in the wind.
- Expression: focused: on his visor, two soft glowing oval eyes held level and steady on the course ahead; no mouth; his body leans a little into the wheel.
- Pose: standing on the deck on the stern side of the wheel, so the wheel is between him and the bow, feet apart for balance and both feet visible on the planks.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: near mitten closed round the handle peg at ten o'clock on the wheel's rim; far mitten closed round the handle peg at two o'clock, both visibly attached to his arms.
- Facing: body faces the bow (right of frame); head turned three-quarters toward the camera so his visor and both eyes read.

### The rigger
- What: a small agent working aloft in the rigging, at the left of the cast.
- Material: smooth, seamless amber-orange glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor.
- Height: about Loop's height, a little rounder; drawn as large as Loop, not shrunk by distance.
- Outfit: a red knit cap with a small pom-pom and a brown leather climbing harness clipped to the ladder.
- Expression: glad: on its visor, two soft glowing eyes gently curved upward into calm crescents; no mouth; its head is lifted toward the envelope with an easy, buoyant posture.
- Pose: a third of the way up a rope ladder at mid-left, its body close against the ladder, both boots standing on one wooden rung.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: both mittens closed round the rung above its head.
- Facing: body side-on to the camera, facing the ladder; head turned three-quarters toward the camera so both eyes read.

### The engineer
- What: a small agent keeping the engine trimmed.
- Material: smooth, seamless sea-blue glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor.
- Height: about Loop's height; kneeling, so its head is level with the valve handwheel.
- Outfit: a brown leather work apron with a small wrench in its pocket.
- Expression: intent: on its visor, two soft glowing eyes lowered steadily toward the valve, held level; no mouth; its shoulders lean in over the work.
- Pose: kneeling on both knees on the open deck at lower left, both knees and both boots visible on the planks.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: both mittens, each with one thumb, closed on the rim of the valve handwheel, turning it.
- Facing: three-quarters toward the camera, looking down at the valve.

## Props
- Ship's wheel: wooden, with a brass hub, on a brass pedestal mid-left. Its axle runs fore and aft, so from this camera the wheel is a narrow, nearly edge-on ellipse with visible spokes and handle pegs.
- Spyglass: short, brass and closed, in the person's near hand at the hip.
- Rope ladder: two side ropes with wooden rungs, tied to brass fittings on the rail and on the envelope's rim band; every rope is attached at both ends.
- Valve: a small brass handwheel lying flat on top of an upright brass pipe that runs into the deck.
- Envelope: a long glass envelope with brass ribs filling the top edge; the gondola hangs under it on ropes from brass fittings, every rope attached at both ends.

## Setting
A glass-and-brass airship gondola with an open oak deck, enclosed on every side by a brass rail with posts and teal-glass lattice panels, sailing above a sea of clouds with snowy peaks. The wind blows from the bow, so everything soft streams back toward the stern (left of frame): both scarves and the cap's pom-pom.

## Light
Low golden sunrise from the right is the key light on every figure, with warm rim light on their right edges and a soft contact shadow under every foot, every knee and under Ouro. # Chart room: ouroboros.bot home, "How I work"

## Story
Before the voyage, a faceless person and Loop, a small glass agent, lean over the same big chart in a lamplit chart room so Loop sets off knowing the route.

## Camera
50 mm lens. Eye level: level with the chart table's top edge, as if we stand at the near end of the table. We look straight down the length of the table toward the round window at the far end. One vanishing point, at the centre of the round window, where the table's edges, the floorboards and the ceiling beams all converge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024 and shipped as an 8:3 strip, so the crop band is rows 224 to 800: every head, mitten, foot and the whole tabletop sit inside it. No words go over the picture, so the safe area is the whole crop band; the top and bottom 22% hold only ceiling beams and floorboards. The person stands at the left side of the table, Loop at the right side, the round window between them at the centre. A 4:3 phone crop centred on the table keeps both figures whole.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless person from the shared universe, the one who decides where the voyage goes.
- Material: smooth, seamless frosted glass with a warm brass core and a soft warm inner light; no face at all.
- Build: chubby, rounded and toy-like: a big soft round head about a third of the body, a soft round torso, short soft limbs, natural adult proportions, never tall and thin.
- Height: the tallest figure; standing, the table top reaches their waist.
- Outfit: a moss-green knitted scarf, both ends hanging still down their chest (indoors, no wind).
- Expression: faceless; calm and engaged, shown by the body: head tilted down toward the chart and turned slightly toward Loop, shoulders relaxed, leaning in a little.
- Pose: standing on the floorboards at the left long side of the table, leaning forward over it.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs, both feet on the floor.
- Hands: round mittens like winter mittens, each with one small thumb. Near (left) mitten: resting flat and closed on the chart's left edge, holding it down. Far (right) mitten: resting closed on the chart's centre, beside a small brass compass.
- Facing: body side-on to the camera, facing right across the table toward Loop; head turned a little toward the camera so the round face-plate reads.

### Loop

# Slugger's balloon: ouroboros.bot home, "It started with Slugger"

## Story
At dawn, Slugger, a small glass raccoon agent, lifts off from a meadow in a little patchwork hot-air balloon, holding his long to-do list, with tiny Ouro riding on the basket's rim.

## Camera
50 mm lens. Eye level: just above the meadow grass, a few steps from the balloon, looking slightly up at it. One vanishing point, on the horizon just left of the balloon, where the meadow's mown path and the far hedgerows converge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024 and shipped as an 8:3 strip, so the crop band is rows 224 to 800: the whole balloon, from the top of its envelope to the bottom of its basket, sits inside that band, centred a little right of the middle. No words go over the picture, so the safe area is the whole crop band; the top and bottom fifths stay calm dawn sky and meadow grass. Open meadow and soft hills fill the left half.

## Cast

### Slugger
- What: Slugger, the agent everything started with: a small raccoon made of glass, friendly and clever.
- Material: smooth, seamless smoky-grey glass lit softly from within, with a darker charcoal-glass mask across his eyes, cream-glass muzzle and cheeks, and a bushy tail ringed in charcoal and grey glass bands; small round glass ears; two glossy dark eyes.
- Height: about as tall as the basket is deep, so the basket's rim reaches his chest and his head and shoulders show above it.
- Outfit: a short moss-green knitted scarf, its two ends blowing to the left in the breeze from the right.
- Expression: delighted and a little proud: eyes bright and wide, a small open smile, ears perked forward.
- Pose: standing in the basket, leaning on its rim, looking out over the meadow toward the camera's left.
- Limbs: exactly two arms (front legs) visible above the rim; his hind legs are hidden inside the basket.
- Hands: small round raccoon paws with no separate fingers. Near paw: holding the top of a long paper to-do list. Far paw: resting on the basket's wicker rim.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned toward the left of frame; head three-quarters toward the camera so both eyes and his mask read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, a tiny snake, from the reference image, along for the ride.
- Material: smooth, seamless translucent emerald glass with an inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face of the reference image.
- Height: the smallest figure; his curl is about as tall as Slugger's head.
- Outfit: none.
- Expression: wide-eyed and happy, as at the start of an adventure.
- Pose: sitting on the basket's wicker rim beside Slugger's far paw, as in the reference: one upright open "O" curl resting on its lowest curve, head at the top, a short tapered tail tip rising beside his head with a clear gap as wide as his eye between tail tip and cheek.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous tapering body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head three-quarters toward the camera, looking out the same way as Slugger.

## Props
- The balloon: a small round hot-air balloon whose envelope is sewn from patches of warm fabric (moss green, cream, rust, mustard, faded sky blue), with visible stitched seams and a darker band at its mouth; it is upright, round side up.
- Basket: a small square wicker basket, its rim wrapped in leather, hanging under the envelope on four ropes, one from each corner to the envelope's load band; every rope is attached at both ends.
